defs.def: paying no attention, even if the situation is bad or there are difficulties 不顾；不加理会

ex.s: According to the experts, problems faced by people regardless of the past and present are the same.
ex.t: 根据专家的说法，人们无论在过去还是现在所面临的问题都是一样的。

ex.s: Thus, the keyboard can determine people's identities, and by extension, whether they should be given access to the computer it's connected to—regardless of whether someone gets the password right.
ex.t: 因此，键盘可以确定人们的身份，进而判断是否应允许他们使用与其连接的电脑——无论某人是否输入了正确的密码。

ex.s: But if he's out there every day and playing hard, you should praise his effort regardless of whether his team wins or loses.
ex.t: 但如果他每天都在那里努力打球，无论他的球队输赢，你都应该赞扬他的努力。

ex.s: Regardless of the weather or the distance, Paul Wilson will make sure low-income students in his neighbourhood arrive at their college classes on time.
ex.t: 无论天气如何，也无论距离多远，Paul Wilson都会确保他所在社区低收入家庭的学生准时到达大学课堂。

ex.s: Freedom Day is held every year on 27 April to celebrate South Africa’s first fully-participated elections in 1994, in which everyone was allowed to vote regardless of skin colour.
ex.t: 每年4月27日是自由日，庆祝南非1994年首次全民参与的选举，在这次选举中，无论肤色如何，每个人都被允许投票。

ex.s: It assists people based on need, regardless of which country they are from.
ex.t: 它根据需求帮助人，无论他们来自哪个国家。

ex.s: Regardless of your past experience, please read these survival tips carefully: • Leave the area quickly but calmly if a wildfire breaks out at any time.
ex.t: 不管你过去的经验如何，请仔细阅读这些生存技巧：• 如果任何时候发生野火，迅速而冷静地离开该区域。

ex.s: She is determined to live a fulfilling life regardless of what the future holds, and to try her best to help patients with this cancer recover in spite of the various difficulties she might face.
ex.t: 她决心无论未来如何都要活得充实，并尽力帮助患这种癌症的病人康复，尽管可能面临各种困难。

ex.s: The picture of Dorian Gray This book by Oscar Wilde tells the story of Dorian Gray, a very handsome young man who spends his life only concerned with his own pleasure, regardless of the suffering he brings to others.
ex.t: 《道林·格雷的画像》：奥斯卡·王尔德的这本书讲述了道林·格雷的故事，他是一个非常英俊的年轻人，一生只关心自己的快乐，不管给别人带来多少痛苦。
